title: Disaster Recovery Loans Help Small Businesses Survive and Rebuild
discussion_signal: The HBS research relay reports that disaster-affected businesses receiving loans were more likely to survive, had lower bankruptcy rates, regained employment, and gained private-credit access, matching the atlas record's liquidity-to-recovery pathway.
linked_research_question: Can emergency liquidity prevent disaster-induced firm exit while supporting employment, revenue, and later access to private credit?
limits: The post provides a short result summary without full design details
Firm-level recovery is not identical to household-level welfare
